exness
The Exness x Onamae VPS matter
A large-scale unauthorized access occurred at the Onamae.com Desktop Cloud (GMO). All servers were stopped, with about 26,000 cases potentially affected. MT4/MT5 login information and the like on the servers was abused, and reports of fraudulent trades keep coming in.
As a result, information is spreading that Exness is temporarily suspending "accounts with a connection history to Onamae VPS" to protect against damage. It seems you can't lift this yourself and have to contact support.

https://t.co/jv0Z5FP3dg

In this incident I was trading on EXNESS, and I was told that damages from the fraudulent trades cannot be compensated.
What a mess~.
I guess I'll have to get GMO to compensate me.

As expected, Exness had temporarily frozen accounts as a countermeasure against Onamae.
I don't know about other brokers, but XS has taken no measures at all
Exness is the only choice now
I'm withdrawing my funds, so from next year.
